name: line-supervisor
description: Supervise one fleet-graph goal line: liveness, spend, blockers; repair without taking over.

interface.shortDescription: Watch one goal line; fix what blocks it; never approve for it.
interface.longDescription: Hourly baseline checklist plus event monitor for a single fleet-graph goal line. Three-rung incident ladder: change facts so the line wakes itself, fix supervisor tooling, file engine defects for the line to dispatch. Gates stay self-judged by the line.
defaultPrompt: Use line-supervisor to run the hourly checklist for line wf-xxxxxx.
